name: Company
text: Barley, Aurdin, Vivian and Lymen are all somewhere in Silverton. Find the others: the Hex, the mission chapel, vice row. Lymen wants you to have made a name first.
doneText: Four of you.

steps.where: Barley, on the bench at the Hex bar. Front his five.
Aurdin, outside Aldwin's mission chapel in the Shaft Rows.
Vivian, selling candles on vice row, south of the Hex.
Lymen, in the Hex. He joins once you have renown.

src: handoff-2026-09-23 §3 (the others hireable in play); hire spots invented.json#hires; steps invented.json#pinned-quest

name: Winters' Errands
text: Ambrose Winters has papers that need carrying, and he doesn't leave the counter. Easy work, and Fountain Street will know your face.
doneText: Fountain Street knows your face. Winters' shelves are open to you.

steps.where: Winters, Acquisitions & Estates. Ask him for WORK.
Aldwyn Androit, the notary on Fountain Street: his seal on the papers.
Casper Venn, the changer on Fountain Street: a value in silver.
Back to Winters with the sealed, valued papers.
Winters has more WORK.
Mical at the Riverside warehouses: she signs the Pryor crate off her books.
Brennan the smith, on the second row of Fountain Street: he's owed the purse.
Back to Winters.

src: RULED 09-24 (Griz: easy 'help people in town' renown, courier missions between important NPCs, Winters starts); invented.json#errands

name: Pete's Five
text: Across the river, the Crawler Warrens. Warrens Pete says six came up. The book has five names with no return line. Past the wet.
doneText: The five came back up. Edric wrote their return lines.

steps.where: Bring the five's gear to Edric Pellam at the tally-house.
Edric Pellam at the tally-house: the Warrens mouth camp, out the east gate and over the bridge.
Skarn, at the mouth camp. Speak to him as a man, and his gate opens.
The flooded stair, past the wet: through Skarn's gate, up the drift, the daytime way down. Bring rope.

name: The Cradles
text: Your name is in Edric's book. The pens are the gated mouths along the mountain at the camp: Two, Four and Five. Six draws to a shift, a silver the clean thimble.
doneText: You've worked the cradles. Any day you like.

steps.where: Pen Two: the gated mouth on the mountain wall of the mouth camp.

src: wiki/the-warrens.md (the dose-rate; six attempts a shift); WarrensModule/handouts/handout-galleries-hands-wanted.md

name: The Cull
text: West of town, the guano mine hires cull hands: three silver a giant-bat head, a gold piece a darkmantle. The one law: no fire, no noise under a roost.
doneText: You kept the law and brought a man up.

steps.where: Sabeth Pollard at the weigh-shed, the guano mine's mouth (west, in the mountain).
The dens, down past the working gallery. Listen for Old Wynn's rattle.

name: The Forty-Gold Tail
text: Forty gold on Hessle's board for the cloaker in the guano mine's deep gallery. Nobody has ever collected. Bright light is its weakness.
doneText: Hessle weighed the tail honestly and opened the drawer.

steps.where: Take the tail to Hessle at the Weigh-House, Fountain Street.
The deep gallery, below the dens: past the mark, down the last ladder. Bring light.

name: The Braiding Ettercap
text: Forty gold, up ten since it snared a lad: the ettercap at the far end of Web Gulch, south of the fork.
doneText: Hessle paid fifty gold. Nobody will ever say why it braided.

steps.where: Take the fangs to Hessle at the Weigh-House.
The far end of Web Gulch: down the silk-cutters' descent, south of the fork.

name: Fight Night
text: The Hex: five silver to fight on the card, winner keeps ten. Korvin keeps the slate. Talmok is the champion.
doneText: You beat Talmok on the sand.

steps.where: Korvin at the slate, in the Hex.

name: The Snoot's Young Blood
text: Gnoll glory-seekers range south of the Halfway Inn. The challenge by day.
doneText: You held the road.

steps.where: The road south of the Halfway Inn.

name: When You're Ready
text: Ambrose Winters, Acquisitions & Estates, Fountain Street. Not ready, not yet. (He will be ready when the one who leads you reaches level 4.)
doneText: The Ring of Binding.

steps.where: Winters, once the one who leads you is level 4. Until then, ask him for work.

name: What the Lake Keeps
text: The Halfway Inn, seventeen miles down the road. The Waterbys. The deep off the point.
doneText: The thing in the lake is dead.

steps.where: The Halfway Inn: south from the fork, past Web Gulch, on the east side of the road.
Elsbeth, at the kitchen tub. She only talks while she works.
Not without help. Winters has something for this, when you're ready.
Take a room from the inn lady, with the ring on.
Down to the point.

name: The One Law
text: The stair behind the Warrens is dry. Find who drained it.
doneText: The Cleric of Solskaft wrote it in her ledger.

steps.where: The Warrens' wet: past the landing with the mark, the stair beyond it.
They'll be back for the rest of it. Give it a few nights, then go down again.
Down through the cut door, along the hallway. Somebody is at the dead.

src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-spine-recut.md §2 beat 1 (the journal gets one line at a time: F8)

name: The King at the Door
text: Ingrith Scalebeam has given you the front door. Go and see the king.
doneText: The king walks his road with you.

steps.where: The Burial's base ring: the door-warden Audun's shield, released to you by the ledger.
Up the dwarves' stair and down the Sunshaft. The king stands at the vault door.

name: The King's Road
text: Pyro walks his road with you, to show you what it's for.
doneText: Halldor's unit was pinned in the north cut. Not now.

steps.where: The highway's mouth, in the works below Solskaft.
Down the road to First Lamp.
Second Lamp, across the great cavern.
The north cut, off the road just short of Second Lamp. Halldor's unit is pinned.

name: Bring Them Home
text: Halldor and his wounded, and the king, back up the road to Solskaft.
doneText: Home. The king trusts you in his halls.

steps.where: Up the road, to the highway's mouth in the works.

name: The Halls Are Yours
text: Muck about, the king says. The halls are yours, and the road is his. Halldor is in the lit barracks, mending.
doneText: Halldor is on his feet, and he knows where the nest is.

steps.where: Halldor, in the lit barracks. Do some good in the halls while he mends.
Halldor, in the muster yard.

src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-spine-recut.md §2 beats 4-5 (a couple of quests later, the captain petitions)

name: The Nest
text: Halldor knows where the nest is, past the neck in the north cut. He didn't have enough. He does now.
doneText: The nest is crushed.

steps.where: The north cut off the road short of Second Lamp, and past the neck.

name: Behind the Fountains
text: The drow have taken Third Lamp. Ingrith needs the road held to Deepholm's door, all four days of it, so she can go down and ask her clan for the trade.
doneText: The road is held to the door.

steps.where: The highway's mouth, in the works. The king and the Cleric are waiting.
Third Lamp. Take it back.
Past Third Lamp, the last day of the road, to Deepholm's door.

src: handoff-2026-09-26-dragonsleep-spine-recut.md §2 beat 6 (now the highway mission goes in the journal)

name: Deepholm's Door
text: The road is held to the door. Pyro said he would let the Cleric go down to Deepholm and consult her clan once it was.
doneText: The Cleric went through. You did not.

steps.where: Back up the lamps: tell the king the road is held.
Ingrith, at her ledger in the tollhouse.
Down to Deepholm's door, with the Cleric.

name: The Heir in the Stacks
text: Aldwin: a dying woman, Wenna, says she was the wife of Asmund of the Silversands, and that a child was hidden in the Shaft Rows the week the gate sealed, and never found.
doneText: The ledger records an heir.

steps.where: Someone who has been in the Rows long enough to know a face that never aged. Old Hob, at the Warrens camp?
The rope-maker in the Shaft Rows.
Ingrith, and the ledger.
Asmund's wedge, at the Burial's base ring.

name: What They Took Down
text: Ingrith needs the count of what the treasury sent to Deepholm. The only count is Androit's father's mine records.
doneText: Ingrith goes down with a number.

steps.where: Androit won't sell. His clerk, Idony, reads everything.
Ask the dwarves what they pay for things brought up from past the seals.
Idony, with the dwarves' answer.
The page, to Ingrith.

name: The Keeper's Water
text: Ragna can reverse the siphon and give the drained stair back its water, and its keeper, if you hold the stair for three nights.
doneText: The stair is water again.

steps.where: The drained stair, in the Warrens' wet.

name: The Wheelwright
text: The one who built the siphon got away. The night crews' tools are made at Brennan's forge.
doneText: The wheelwright answered for it, one way or another.

steps.where: Brennan's forge, in the second block.

name: The Tariff Board
text: The last surface goods ever tolled through Deepholm's gate: a caravan off the Coldridge route. Mical keeps manifests.
doneText: The caravan was never lost.

steps.where: Mical, at the warehouses on the riverside.
